use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use Colour = (red: double, green: double, blue: double)

let width = 240
let height = 180
let frames = 60
let thickness = 24

let bars: (colour: Colour, phase: double)[] = [
    (colour = (red = 1.0D, green = 0.25D, blue = 0.2D), phase = 0.0D),
    (colour = (red = 1.0D, green = 0.8D, blue = 0.2D), phase = 0.35D),
    (colour = (red = 0.3D, green = 1.0D, blue = 0.35D), phase = 0.7D),
    (colour = (red = 0.25D, green = 0.6D, blue = 1.0D), phase = 1.05D),
    (colour = (red = 0.8D, green = 0.35D, blue = 1.0D), phase = 1.4D)
]

channel(value: double) -> ubyte =>
    cast ubyte(Math.round(255.0D * Math.clamp(value, 0.0D, 1.0D)))

draw_bar(image: IMAGE, colour: Colour, top: double) is
    for row in 0..thickness do
        let across = (cast double(row) + 0.5D) / cast double(thickness)
        let shine = Math.sin(across * Math.pi)
        let glint = Math.pow(shine, 12.0D) * 0.5D
        let y = top + cast double(row)

        image.colour(
            channel(colour.red * shine + glint),
            channel(colour.green * shine + glint),
            channel(colour.blue * shine + glint))

        image.fill_rectangle(0.0D, y, cast double(width), y + 1.0D)
    od
si

draw(image: IMAGE, time: double) is
    image.clear(0ub, 0ub, 10ub)

    let travel = cast double(height - thickness) / 2.0D

    for bar in bars do
        let top =
            Math.round(travel + travel * Math.sin(time - bar.phase))

        draw_bar(image, bar.colour, top)
    od
si

let image = IMAGE(width, height)
let animation = ANIMATION(width, height)

for frame in 0..frames do
    let time = 2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(frame) / cast double(frames)

    draw(image, time)
    animation.add(image, 40)
od

write_line("{bars.count} bars, one period of their sway in {frames} frames")

animation.write("bars.png")

animation.show("bars.png")
